title.zh: Photon-Emission-Guided Laser Fault Injection Enables RP2350 Secure Debug
title.en: Photon-Emission-Guided Laser Fault Injection Enables RP2350 Secure Debug

current_state.zh: Researchers demonstrate a photon-emission-guided laser fault injection attack that bypasses the RP2350 microcontroller's secure debug protections, requiring physical access and roughly $250,000 in laboratory equipment.
current_state.en: Researchers demonstrate a photon-emission-guided laser fault injection attack that bypasses the RP2350 microcontroller's secure debug protections, requiring physical access and roughly $250,000 in laboratory equipment.
